nota: EN01 Lily gets home: solo lo que falta en la biblioteca.

efectos.texto: A school bus pulling away from the curb on a quiet suburban street, short air brake release hiss, then the diesel engine revs gently and fades into the distance. No horn, no voices, no music.
efectos.usar_para: autobús escolar que se va (fuera de cuadro), de lejos

efectos.texto: Smart door lock keypad: four quick soft electronic button beeps, then a short motorized deadbolt whirr and a solid click as it unlocks. Close, clean, nothing else.
efectos.usar_para: código en el teclado de la cerradura inteligente y el cerrojo que se abre

efectos.texto: A cat hops down from a cushioned window seat and lands softly on a wooden floor, light thump of paws, then a few soft padded steps. Indoors, close.
efectos.usar_para: gato que salta al piso de madera y da unos pasos

efectos.texto: One short soft friendly meow from a calm adult house cat, indoors, close, clean, nothing else.
efectos.usar_para: un maullido corto y amistoso (alinear con la boca abierta)

efectos.texto: A contented cat purring steadily and warmly, close, indoors, calm. No voices, no music.
efectos.usar_para: gato ronroneando mientras lo acarician o se frota

efectos.texto: Light footsteps of a child in sneakers walking across a wooden floor indoors, relaxed pace, soft rustle of a backpack. No voices, no music.
efectos.usar_para: pasos ligeros de una niña con tenis en piso de madera

efectos.texto: Central air conditioning switching on indoors: a soft relay click, then a gentle airflow whoosh from a ceiling vent rising to a steady calm hum. No voices, no music.
A pencil writing on paper at a quiet kitchen counter, soft scratching strokes and a page turning, calm indoor room tone. No voices, no music.
efectos.usar_para: alguien escribiendo o haciendo tareas en la mesa/isla
